input_path.description: S3 file or folder to compress. A folder is archived recursively: zip members are relative to it, tar members sit under a top-level directory named after it.

output_path.description: S3 path of the archive to write. Must end with the format's extension. Defaults to next to the input, named <base name><extension>.

overwrite.description: Replace the archive if output_path already exists. Defaults to false.
